note_on_earlier_truncation: a first pass summed k*P(K=k) only to k=11 and returned 1089/455; including k=12 restores E[K] = 12/5 exactly, as linearity of expectation requires. Recorded rather than silently corrected.
derivation: K >= k iff the top k of the 16 combined order statistics are all fresh, so P(K>=k) = prod_{i=0}^{k-1} (12-i)/(16-i). k=3 gives (12/16)(11/15)(10/14) = 165/420 = 11/28.
assumptions: continuous marginals, ties have probability zero
tube = max of the 4 calibration scores
no selection of the calibration set using outcomes
what_this_does_NOT_establish: three historical exceedances among twelve are entirely ordinary under exchangeability: E[K] = 2.4 and P(K >= 3) = 11/28 ~ 0.393. They therefore do not by themselves establish population non-transfer, and they reclassify no frozen gate.
